Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Cognizant Romania is home to 2400+ creative technologists and is one of Eastern Europe's largest Software Product Engineering delivery networks. We serve global clients in several industries, including Banking & Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Communication Media & Technology, and Retail & MLEU (manufacturing, logistics, energy & utilities).
 Cognizant Romania was established in 2018 when Cognizant acquired Softvision, a company founded in the late 1990s in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. We continue to build on our history as the preferred engineering partner for thriving Silicon Valley tech companies, now as a prominent Cognizant next generation studio.
 About the role 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Fullstack Developer with strong Python skills and solid experience with TypeScript and React to join our engineering team.
 You will work on modern, scalable applications, contributing across the full development lifecycle, from solution design and implementation to automated testing and production.
 The role requires strong end-to-end ownership and the ability to work effectively with engineers, scientists and business stakeholders in a collaborative environment.
 Your responsibilities 
Design, develop and maintain scalable applications using Python, TypeScript and React .
Build backend services and integrate enterprise systems through REST APIs .
Develop and maintain modern frontend applications using React and TypeScript .
Design and support event-driven solutions , including asynchronous workers, retries and failure handling.
Work with Pub/Sub or similar messaging technologies .
Develop and maintain automated tests using Playwright and pytest .
Work with workflow and job orchestration solutions.
Build secure enterprise integrations using SSO and OAuth .
Work with object storage solutions such as Google Cloud Storage (GCS) or Amazon S3 .
Design and maintain relational data models using SQL/PostgreSQL , including schema design and migrations.
Implement and maintain application observability across logging, metrics, tracing and alerting .
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation using GitHub Actions and Terraform .
Troubleshoot complex development and production issues.
Take end-to-end ownership of solutions, from implementation and testing through deployment and production.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.
Collaborate closely with engineers, scientists and business stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.
 What you bring 
 5+ years of fullstack software development experience .
Strong hands-on development experience with Python .
Solid experience with TypeScript and React .
Experience with workflow or job orchestration.
Hands-on experience with automated testing using Playwright and pytest .
Experience with event-driven architectures , including Pub/Sub or similar technologies, asynchronous workers, retries and failure handling.
Experience designing and integrating REST APIs .
Good understanding of enterprise integration and authentication patterns, including SSO and OAuth .
Experience working with object storage solutions such as GCS or S3 .
Strong knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL , including schema design and database migrations.
Good understanding of application observability, including logging, metrics, tracing and alerting .
Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Terraform and CI/CD practices .
Good understanding of Generative AI and LLM concepts and their use within modern software applications.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of the software engineering lifecycle.
Strong end-to-end ownership, with experience taking solutions from development and testing through production.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Strong English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
 Technology stack 
 Python | TypeScript | React | Playwright | pytest | REST APIs | Pub/Sub | PostgreSQL | SQL | GCS/S3 | SSO/OAuth | GitHub Actions | Terraform | CI/CD 
 Cognizant Romania Employee Benefits: 
 Flexible Work Schedule – Outside of core working hours, you have the flexibility to arrange your schedule in a way that best suits your personal and professional needs.
 Flexible Hybrid Approach – We support a hybrid working model that helps you balance remote and office work. Employees based near a Cognizant office are expected to spend a minimum of 4 days per month onsite.
 Annual Leave – Enjoy 26 vacation days each year to relax, recharge, travel, and spend quality time with family and friends.
 Learning & Development – Access a wide range of training programs, workshops, certifications, and continuous learning opportunities to support your professional growth.
 Private Medical Insurance – Comprehensive healthcare coverage for your wellbeing and peace of mind.
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential professional support services to help you navigate personal, emotional, financial, legal, or work-related challenges.
 Meal Tickets – Monthly meal allowance provided through meal vouchers.
 Referral Bonus Program – Help us grow our team and be rewarded for successful referrals.
 Life Insurance – Additional protection and financial security
 Banking Benefits – Preferential banking services and financial products through our partner institutions.
 Bookster Library – Access thousands of books, audiobooks, and learning resources to support both personal and professional development.
